Test-optional for Spring 2027, Fall 2027 and Spring 2028 entry. No superscoring (highest composite by test date only); self-reported scores not accepted, so submitted scores must be official

$27,292 (in-state aid recipients, 2023-24); College Navigator income brackets cover in-state students only, so out-of-state net price will be much higher

Yes. Incoming students with an activated NetID are automatically considered for many scholarships; others need a separate application in the Wisconsin Scholarship Hub (WiSH), often before admission
2026-27 estimated cost of attendance: Wisconsin resident $31,524; non-resident $65,120; Minnesota reciprocity $37,574. Tuition differentials: Engineering +$3,200, Business +$3,000, Nursing +$1,500
Early Action (non-binding, non-restrictive) Nov 1, materials Nov 9, decision by Jan 31 (admit, deny or defer); Regular Decision Jan 15, materials Jan 22, decision by Mar 31. No Early Decision
No admission interview; CDS C7 lists interview as 'not considered'

Most students declare a major after enrolling. Direct entry (competitive) for Business, Engineering, Dance and Music: list it as first-choice major. Engineering applicants must list a non-engineering second choice; business applicants not directly admitted enter as pre-business. Dance and Music need a separate department application and audition. All applicants give a first and second choice major
One letter of recommendation is required (a second is optional); engineering applicants are encouraged to use a math or science teacher

supplements.label: Why UW–Madison (all applicants; 650 max, 300-500 recommended)
supplements.prompt: Tell us why you would like to attend the University of Wisconsin–Madison. In addition, please include why you are interested in studying the major(s) you have selected. If you selected undecided, please describe your areas of possible academic interest.

supplements.label: Personal essay (Universities of Wisconsin Application only; Common App users write a Common App essay instead)
supplements.prompt: Each student is unique. Please tell us about the particular life experiences, talents, commitments, and/or interests you will bring to our campus.
